Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [First shipment was like a Greek party](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64db8dc48939eed74a3b2631)
First shipment was like a Greek party, at least 50% of the plates were broken due to poor packaging. The replacement was smooth & fast and in that shipment only 1 plate was broken, again due to poor packing. If L&G would spend a few $$ on better protecting their merchandise, they could significantly lower the price we pay, because it's hard to believe that I am the only customer where 2 out 2 shipments had issues.

August 8, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 16, 2023

Hi There,

Thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear your original dinnerware arrived damaged but glad our team has resolved this in a timely manner. We will share the packaging needs with our operation team so they can further review it. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
